name: leimoz
description: LeiMoz — Plataforma Nacional de Literacia Jurídica de Moçambique

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate
scripts.db:seed: npm --prefix backend run seed && npm --prefix backend run seed:embeddings
scripts.db:seed:lei: npm --prefix backend run seed:lei && npm --prefix backend run seed:embeddings
scripts.dev: concurrently -n docker,backend,frontend -c blue,green,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run docker:up && npm run db:wait" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.setup: npm run docker:up && npm run db:wait && npm run install:all && npm run db:seed
scripts.setup:full: npm run docker:up && npm run db:wait && npm run install:all && npm run db:seed && npm run db:seed:lei
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
